name: Forest Goblins

specialRules.name: Natives
specialRules.text: Suffer no movement penalties from moving through any wooded terrain.

specialRules.name: Animosity
specialRules.text: Standard rules for Animosity (as per the Orc Mob Rules in the Mordheim Annual 2002). Braves, Forest Goblins, Red Toof Boyz and Sluggas are subject to it; a Brave may remove his Animosity instead of choosing a skill.

items.name: Boss Pole
items.note: Acts as a spear (Strike First); the hero and any Goblin henchmen within 6" ignore animosity. Forest Goblins only.

items.name: Blowpipe
items.note: Range 8", S1, save modifier +1 (positive), Poison (natural 12 to hit automatically wounds; cannot cause critical hits), Stealthy (can fire while hidden without revealing position; target may take an Initiative test to spot him). Forest Goblins only.

equipmentLists.name: Forest Goblin special equipment
equipmentLists.usedBy: Forest Goblins only (poison, Magic Gubbinz, Red Toof Tribal Jewellery, Giant Spider)

items.name: Poisoned Weapon
items.note: Common. Applied to one weapon, cannot be traded or sold; the weapon adds +1 to injury rolls.

items.name: Magic Gubbinz
items.note: Rare 9. Shaman only: may re-roll a failed magic test on a D12 roll of 7+.

items.name: Red Toof Tribal Jewellery
items.note: Rare 9. Cannot be removed; model becomes subject to Frenzy.

items.name: Giant Spider
items.note: Rare 11, mount. M7 WS3 BS0 S3(4) T3 W1 I4 A1 Ld4. Poisoned Attack: attacks count as Strength 4 but do not modify armour saves. Wall Walk: spider and rider may walk up and down walls without Initiative tests; may jump up to 2" across or down (counts as a diving charge); when a spider jumps its rider tests Initiative, on a fail roll on the Whoa Boy! table; max diving charge 2" even with Running Dismount.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Chieftain may use his Leadership value when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Ride Spiders
specialRules.text: May ride Giant Spiders and the Gigantic Spider as detailed in the 'Blazing Saddles' article (Mordheim Annual, page 65).

specialRules.name: Sluggas
specialRules.text: In the shooting phase may throw thrown weapons up to three times. May not be combined with Quick Shot if promoted to hero.

fighters.name: Gigantic Spider
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never needs or uses weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Poisonous
specialRules.text: When it wounds an enemy, injury roll: 1-2 knocked down, 3-8 stunned, 9-12 out of action.

specialRules.name: Native
specialRules.text: No movement penalty in wooded terrain.

specialRules.name: Non-sentient
specialRules.text: Subject to stupidity; never gains experience (but may climb as normal).

specialRules.name: May Ride
specialRules.text: The Chieftain may ride it: +1 armour save, moves at the spider's M6. Shooting hits the Chieftain on 1-4 and the spider on 5-12; in close combat the opponent chooses. The spider does not test for stupidity while ridden.

fighters.notes: Limit 0-1. Not bought in groups; the Chieftain may ride it.

conversionNotes: Blowpipe Poison: 'roll a 6 to hit' -> natural 12. Save modifier +1 and the 'no save gets 6+' wording left as printed in the item note (not converted; 6+ would be natural 12).
Magic Gubbinz: re-roll on D6 4+ -> D12 7+.
Gigantic Spider injury table 1 / 2-4 / 5-6 -> 1-2 / 3-8 / 9-12; shooting split 1-2 / 3-6 -> 1-4 / 5-12 (proportional, judgement call).
Forest Goblin Magic spell table (D6, difficulties) is in the PDF but not transcribed; only the list name is recorded.

Special equipment (Poisoned Weapon, Magic Gubbinz, Red Toof Tribal Jewellery, Giant Spider) put in a third list 'special'; availability (Common/Rare 9/Rare 11) is in notes. Magic Gubbinz is Shaman-only by context; Red Toof Tribal Jewellery has no stated user.
Gigantic Spider is a 0-1 henchman-style entry at 200gc; Chieftain riding rules in specialRules. Giant Spider mount (100gc) is an equipment item.
Chieftain is also referenced 'Ride Spiders' per Mordheim Annual article not in PDF.
Max profile (Characteristic Increase): M4 WS5 BS6 S4 T4 W3 I6 A4 Ld7 (not in schema).
Equipment text 'Two-handed weapon' and 'Throwing Weapons' / 'Light Armour' capitalisation copied as printed.
